claims.statement: For every quadratic Boolean control phase q, arbitrary Boolean g on a disjoint block, and every finite adaptive/pruned physical restriction tree on the control block with no coordinate repeated on a path, U(qg)-sum_l w_l U(q_l g) <= 3 sum_v w_v Inf_{i_v}(q_v g) <= 3 I(q).
quantifiers: all finite control dimensions and polar ranks
all quadratic coefficient graphs and affine shifts
all finite adaptive/pruned uniform physical restriction trees
coordinates may repeat at incomparable nodes but not on one path
claims.class_extension: arbitrary overlapping quadratic controls, adaptive pruning, branchwise coordinate reuse, and arbitrary retained disjoint cores
limitations: activation probabilities are dyadic reach probabilities under uniform physical restriction
does not pay for the retained core and does not prove full FEI

claims.statement: In any finite adaptive physical restriction tree with no coordinate repeated on a path, sum over nodes querying i of w_v Inf_i(F_v) <= Inf_i(F); therefore total queried influence is at most root influence.
claims.proof_key: Reach cylinders for nodes querying a fixed coordinate are pairwise disjoint and invariant under that coordinate flip.

claims.statement: Obtain a dimension-free approximate coset-merge bound stable under adaptive iteration when queried controls are coupled to arbitrary nonflat shared cores.
claims.next_test: quadratic control coupled to a one-point-defect core
